title: Host check: Ollama image generation, then record runtime A or B
goal: Host check: Ollama image generation, then record runtime A or B
acceptance: On the owner's host, read-only and with no model download: `ollama --version`, `ollama list` and the documented image-generation API are checked against the decision page, and the result is recorded in docs/decisions/image-generation.md

Runtime A is recorded if the host offers Ollama image generation with a model that fits beside the judge (peak 8 to 12 GB, never both loaded); otherwise runtime B (ComfyUI on loopback) is recorded, and F-021-T03 and F-021-T04 are re-estimated by the decision page's 1 to 2 h before they start
The generator and judge models to pull by digest, and the pull commands, are written into the decision page for F-021-T07
privacy: Neutral invented cases and fixtures only; no consumer data, private reports or credentials in Git.
validation: Recorded host output (versions only, no paths or personal data); npm run check:backlog; CI
escalation: No knowledge of any consumer; a consumer-specific need goes to that consumer's backlog
Material scope or effort growth goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Planned 2026-11-26 after the owner accepted runtime A conditional on a host check; widened the same day to Qwen Image 2.1 (owner: "Qwen Image 2.1 and Ollama check ok"). Not a measurement. No actual: elapsed time not tracked in this session.
